test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Five friends Tam, Tan, Tap, Tab and Tat are standing in a column facing north. Tam stands behind Tan. Tat stands immediately behind Tap. Only one person stands in between Tat and Tam. Tab stands immediately behind Tam. Tab stands at the end of the column. Who stands at the front of the column?
solution: Five friends **Tam, Tan, Tap, Tab and Tat** are standing in a column facing north. 1. Tab stands at the end of the column. 2. Tab stands immediately behind Tam. 3. Tam stands behind Tan.
